question: Which of the following sense is detected by gustatory receptors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Taste**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Gustatory receptors are specialized sensory cells responsible for detecting the **sensation of taste**.
 
• These receptors are primarily located on the **tongue** within taste buds, but they can also be found on the roof of the mouth and throat.
 
• The human tongue contains different types of taste buds, categorized into five primary tastes: **sweet, salty, sour, bitter, and umami** (savory).
 
• Each taste bud consists of taste receptor cells, which interact with chemical substances from food to generate a neural signal interpreted as taste by the **brain**.
 
• These receptors are essential for detecting flavors
